cases: empty gallery and icon-only accessible toolbar
host SVG/image/button theme rules cannot penetrate the gallery ShadowRoot
wide and tall images retain all four colored corners in row and main-image modes
slash is the sole insertion entry; no breadcrumb or command-palette entry is registered
large single-row scrolling at wide and narrow widths, without wrapping
equal inline modes persist and preserve independent row/selection state through host disposal
thumbnail strip centers when short and keeps a selected item visible when overflowing
image zoom is separate from mode; actual pixels, fit and keyboard navigation work
captions are inert text; reorder/remove preserve the selected image and never delete files
batch paste accepts duplicate filenames with legacy succMap and native asset protection
file picker and drop accept modern succFiles; ordinary editor paste is untouched
copied local assets are reused instead of uploading the accompanying clipboard bitmap
Base64 clipboard images are localized and not embedded in block JSON
partial upload failure preserves successes and reports the error
mode changes while uploading merge the latest saved layout and keep imported images
simultaneous recovery and mode saving serialize writes rather than coalescing stale image snapshots
rejected writes persist recovery and restore each uploaded image once
closing the originating editor during upload retains recoverable images
readonly modes and previews work locally without any kernel writes
v1 source is readable without content rewrite until the first intentional edit
corrupt or newer block formats remain visible and are never overwritten
Markdown export and saved image-size/caption settings retain real content
remote streams are bounded and invalid remote formats are rejected
disable aborts pending imports, removes observers/listeners and makes no late writes
dark theme, narrow controls and reduced motion keep layout and navigation usable
environment: Headless Chromium with exact shipped bundle, mock SiYuan SDK/kernel; not a real SiYuan installation.
